messages:
Ava: noticing a perf regression on long sequences (>=2048). suspecting kernel-selection path is flipping to a slower codepath for certain arch+seq combos. can we enable more verbose kernel decision telemetry for a short window?

Ravi: +1. saw p95/p99 jump on canary yesterday. we should avoid full debug due to cost. propose sampled decision traces for seq>1024 and only when reason != cached.

Marta: agree. we need: kernel id, chosen_impl, reason, heuristics inputs (seq_len, batch_size, device_arch, kv_active), and a lightweight trace id. also capture kv cache hit flag.

Ava: proposed env flags:
```
REDWOOD_KERNEL_DECISION_TRACE=1
REDWOOD_KERNEL_DECISION_SAMPLE_RATE=0.01   # 1% overall sampling
REDWOOD_KERNEL_DECISION_MIN_SEQ=1024
REDWOOD_KV_TRACE=1                         # include kv hit/miss tag
```

Ravi: 1% might still be heavy on busy hosts. can we do conditional sampling by route? e.g. only for routes flagged "autotune-explore".

Marta: yes, we have route metadata. add ROUTE_TAG_FILTER=autotune-explore. also add PER_HOST_CAP=5 to limit logs per host per minute.

Jo: curious about overhead. running a micro-profile on canary: seq=4096, batch=1, before: p99=720ms, after enabling full trace (2s sampling) p99=870ms. so ~20% tail hit under full trace. with 0.1% samples overhead is negligible.

Sam: can we narrow the reasons we log? only log when chosen_impl != preferred_impl || decision_reason=="autotune_swap" || kernel_time_estimate_delta>0.2. that will cut noise.

Ava: good call. new filter config (yaml):
```yaml
decision_trace:
  enabled: true
  sample_rate: 0.005   # 0.5% global
  min_seq_len: 1024
  route_filter: ["autotune-explore"]
  per_host_cap: 5
  reason_whitelist: ["autotune_swap","fallback_capacity","arch_mismatch"]
  metrics_only_if_diff: true
```

infra-bot: logs ingestion policy updated. traces matching tag `decision_trace=1` -> low-volume-s3-bucket, retention 30d. alerting: if traces/sec > 100 across prod, pause sampling.

Ravi: can somebody push the env flags to the canary cluster today and collect 24h window? I'll prepare a dashboard with fields: chosen_impl, reason, seq_len, batch_size, device_arch, kv_hit, trace_id.

Marta: I'll handle the canary rollout and add the per-host limiter. starting rollout in 15m. will tag telemetry with trace_id and route_id.

Jo: i'll run a quick profiler on the canary after 2h and post numbers. keen to see which impls are being picked for ampere-v2 vs ampere-v1 for seq 2048-8192.

Sam: if we find false positives (i.e., debug shows reasons but no perf delta) we'll add a follow-up that logs estimated token-cost delta instead of full stack traces.

Ava: plan sounds good. Marta -> canary, Ravi -> dashboard, Jo -> profiler, Sam -> followup logging filter. ping me when traces start flowing. :thumbsup:

Marta: rolling now. will update with initial trace count in ~30m. :rocket:
